name: Golgotha
brief: The place where Jesus was crucified, meaning "Place of a Skull."
short: Golgotha, also known as the Place of a Skull, was the site outside Jerusalem where Jesus was crucified (<ref="Matthew 27:33; Mrk.15.22; Luke 23:33; Jhn.19.17">Matthew 27:33; Mrk.15.22; Luke 23:33; Jhn.19.17</ref>).
